title: Aircraft cursor
description: Aircraft Cursor is a client-side addon for the Immersive Aircraft mod that displays visual indicators on the edges of your screen, pointing in the direction of nearby enemy aircraft that are out of your field of view.
body:
# Aircraft Cursor (Radar)

**Aircraft Cursor** is a lightweight, client-side Minecraft mod designed to improve your situational awareness and safety while flying. No more blinding head-on collisions or losing track of your flight formation!

The mod introduces a clean, minimal **circular radar GUI** directly in the center of your screen (integrated into your crosshair). 

---

### 🚀 Features

* **Dynamic Visibility:** The radar is intelligent. It stays completely hidden during regular gameplay to keep your HUD clean, and **only activates automatically when you are sitting/riding inside an aircraft**.
* **Proximity Tracking:** Displays real-time positioning and proximity of any nearby aircraft relative to you.
* **Minimalist Design:** Positioned right at the center of the screen so you can monitor your surroundings without taking your eyes off your flight path.

---

### 🛠️ Compatibility & Requirements

* This is a **Client-Side** mod. You do not need to install it on the server to work, but it is highly recommended for multiplayer servers with heavy aviation action!
* *Note: Designed to work seamlessly with aircraft-focused mods (such as Immersive Aircraft).*

---
